name: 3D Binary Sphere Kernel Generation
aliases: Sphere Volume Generation for Marching Cubes
definition: A procedural method to generate a 3D scalar field (density texture) representing a sphere, used as input for GPU Marching Cubes. The sphere is centered at the origin of the voxel grid and its radius oscillates over time.
summary: 3D Binary Sphere Kernel Generation procedurally creates a dynamic, oscillating binary density texture for GPU Marching Cubes, distinguishing itself from static voxelization through its time-varying radius.
